title: Skyrim on PS5 gets 3 expansion-sized Creations ⚔️
subject: skyrim
description:
Which one are you playing first? 👇

Three Kinggath Creations for Skyrim Anniversary Edition, East Empire Expansion, Bards College Expansion and Sigil of the Fallen, are now on PS5. The bundle costs 1,850 Creation Credits (about $18) for a limited time, and official Creations don't disable trophies.

Sources: The Elder Scrolls on X (Oct 12, 2026), Push Square (Oct 13, 2026), Kinggath Creations
Game footage © Bethesda Softworks.

scenes.text: Skyrim on PS5 just got three expansion-sized add-ons.
They're official Creations from Kinggath Creations, and The Elder Scrolls account confirmed them on October 12.
Bards College Expansion is about music, insult duels and a brand new skill system.
Sigil of the Fallen sends you after the relics of ancient heroes, with a four-in-one spirit companion.
In East Empire Expansion, you help the trading company spread across all nine holds.
The bundle is 1,850 Creation Credits, about $18, and official Creations don't disable trophies.
